details: Ultragoal session initialized: add settings switch to override fast track mode so full swarm is utilized on simple tasks.
Goal 1 completed: Added forceFullSwarm to AppSettings, SwarmEngineSettings, SettingsModal Swarm tab UI, and App.tsx state.
Goal 2 completed: Extended ModelRouter (evaluateFastPath, isFastPathEligible, inferComplexity), SwarmEngine, server.ts, and SwarmClient to honor forceFullSwarm override.
Goal 3 completed: Added unit tests in failover-timeout.test.ts and test-portable-swarm.ts; built client and swarm bundles; all 5 test suites passed (portable, simulation, dist, cli, server).
Ultragoal session initialized: Implement dynamic task routing to prevent resource bottlenecks and balance token allocation across specialist agents.

Goal 1 completed: Implemented TokenBudgetManager and SpecialistAffinityRouter in src/swarm/loadBalancer.ts; added comprehensive test suite in loadBalancer.test.ts (7/7 tests passed); all builds and test suites passing.

Goal 2 completed: Integrated dynamic specialist routing into src/swarm/engine.ts (Step 4), routing chunks to best-suited specialists via domain affinity and token capacity, emitting 'Specialist Dynamic Routing' events, and verified 100% passing tests in engine-routing.test.ts.

Goal 3 completed: Wired dynamic routing and token budget telemetry into SwarmEventTimeline UI, built both client and swarm production bundles, and verified 100% passing across all 5 test suites and 8 vitest suites.
Ultragoal session initialized: Swarm Optimization Roadmap (Priority 1: Key Metrics Baselines, Priority 2: Semantic Baseline Caching, Priority 3: Reinforcement Learning Adaptive Scheduling).

Goal 1 completed: Implemented SwarmMetricsCollector and calculateLatencyDistribution in src/swarm/profiler.ts, integrated telemetry baselines into src/swarm/engine.ts, and verified 100% passing tests in profiler.test.ts, engine-routing.test.ts, and all 5 E2E suites.

Goal 2 completed: Implemented SemanticSimilarityEngine and SemanticBaselineCache in src/swarm/cache.ts, integrated Step 0c semantic cache short-circuit in src/swarm/engine.ts, verified 12/12 passing tests in cache.test.ts, rebuilt dist/swarm, and verified all 5 E2E suites passing.

Goal 3 completed: Implemented SpecialistCapabilityProfiler with UCB1 reward scoring in src/swarm/loadBalancer.ts, integrated RL capability scoring into SpecialistAffinityRouter and Step 4 routing/outcomes in src/swarm/engine.ts, verified 11/11 tests in loadBalancer.test.ts and 4/4 in engine-routing.test.ts, rebuilt dist/swarm, and passed 100% of all 5 E2E suites and 52 unit tests.
Ultragoal session initialized: Implement adaptive load balancing to allocate tasks based on node capacity.

Goal 1 completed: Implemented NodeCapacityManager in src/swarm/loadBalancer.ts to model concurrency limits, in-flight workloads, slot acquire/release lifecycle, and capacity metrics; added comprehensive unit tests (15/15 passed) in loadBalancer.test.ts; rebuilt dist/swarm; all 5 E2E suites and 56 vitest tests passing.

Goal 2 completed: Extended SpecialistAffinityRouter in src/swarm/loadBalancer.ts to evaluate real-time node capacity headroom, avoid saturated nodes, mark isSpillover and reason on assignments, and report nodeHeadroom/isSaturated in specialistSummary; verified 17/17 tests in loadBalancer.test.ts; rebuilt dist/swarm; all 5 E2E suites and 58 vitest tests passing.

Goal 3 completed: Integrated node capacity slot acquire/release lifecycle into executeAnalyst in src/swarm/engine.ts, mapped node identities accurately, emitted nodeCapacity metrics in Specialist Dynamic Routing events, and verified 100% passing across 9 vitest test suites (59/59 tests) and all 5 E2E test suites (test:portable, test:simulation, test:dist, test:cli, test:server).
Ultragoal session initialized: Introduce hierarchical communication layers to reduce message overhead and latency among swarm agents.

Goal 1 completed: Implemented HierarchicalMessageBus, ClusterNode, CommunicationLayer, and scoped routing (local, cluster, upward, targeted, broadcast) in src/swarm/communication.ts; created comprehensive unit test suite in src/swarm/communication.test.ts (9/9 tests passed); built ESM, CJS, and .d.ts distribution bundles; verified all 10 vitest suites (68/68 tests) and 5 E2E suites passing 100%.

Goal 3 completed: Integrated HierarchicalMessageBus and ClusterDigests into src/swarm/engine.ts (Step 4 & Step 5), emitted Hierarchical Swarm Communication telemetry events, rendered cluster digests and compression metrics in SwarmEventTimeline UI, added integration tests in engine-routing.test.ts (6/6 passed), built client and swarm bundles, and verified 100% passing across all 10 vitest suites (72/72 tests) and all 5 E2E test suites (test:portable, test:simulation, test:dist, test:cli, test:server).
Ultragoal session initialized: Manager Multi-Stage Streaming (Stream real-time cluster digests over SSE before Manager synthesis completes).

Goal 1 completed: Implemented SwarmStagePayload and onStage hooks in src/swarm/engine.ts, forwarded swarm_stage SSE events in src/swarm/server.ts, extended StreamEventPayload in src/swarm/client.ts (streamEmbedded and streamRemote), and verified with new test in src/swarm/sse-resilience.test.ts (3/3 passed).

Goal 2 completed: Extended AnalysisViewer.tsx to render interim progressive cluster digest cards, key findings, anomalies, and token reduction pills during active manager synthesis; hooked up progressiveStage state in src/App.tsx to consume swarm_stage SSE events; verified clean build in npm run build:client.

Goal 3 completed: Extended test-sse-server.mjs with multi-stage SSE verification (both fast-path and full swarm cluster digest progressive stages verified), rebuilt client and swarm distribution bundles (dist/ and dist/swarm/), and passed 100% of all 10 vitest suites (73/73 tests) and all 5 E2E suites (test:portable, test:simulation, test:dist, test:cli, test:server).
Ultragoal session initialized: Dynamic Cluster Auto-Discovery & Rebalancing (Automatically elect cluster leads and rebalance pods based on task domain distributions).

Goal 2 completed: Integrated ClusterTopologyManager auto-discovery and lead election into src/swarm/engine.ts Step 4; emitted topology telemetry in Hierarchical Swarm Communication event and onStage; added getCapabilityScore and getNodeHeadroom in loadBalancer.ts; verified 7/7 passing tests in engine-routing.test.ts.

Goal 3 completed: Rebuilt client and swarm distribution bundles (dist/ and dist/swarm/); verified CommonJS and ESM dist exports with ClusterTopologyManager; passed 100% of all 10 vitest suites (78/78 tests) and all 5 E2E test suites (test:portable, test:simulation, test:dist, test:cli, test:server).
Ultragoal session initialized: Semantic Memory Vector Indexing (Deploy semantic memory indexing with vector embeddings for O(log n) retrieval vs current O(n) linear search).

Goal 1 completed: Implemented MetricMath, VectorIndex interface, VpTreeIndex with O(log n) triangle-inequality metric pruning, and HnswVectorIndex with multi-layer proximity graph routing in src/swarm/vectorIndex.ts; verified 11/11 passing tests in src/swarm/vectorIndex.test.ts.

Goal 2 completed: Integrated VectorIndex (VpTreeIndex with variance-optimized vantage points and spherical shell lower bounding) into MemoryCortex and SemanticBaselineCache; verified O(log n) sub-linear deduplication and retrieval across 7/7 tests in memory-indexing.test.ts.

Goal 3 completed: Exported vectorIndex from library exports and package.json; rebuilt client and swarm distribution bundles (dist/ and dist/swarm/); verified CommonJS and ESM dist exports with VpTreeIndex and HnswVectorIndex; passed 100% of all 12 vitest suites (96/96 tests) and all 5 E2E test suites (test:portable, test:simulation, test:dist, test:cli, test:server).
Ultragoal session initialized: Enable speculative parallel execution with conflict resolution for independent subtasks to reduce latency by 40-60%.

Goal 1 completed: Implemented DependencyGraph, ConflictResolver, and SpeculativeExecutionCoordinator in src/swarm/speculative.ts; verified 9/9 passing tests in src/swarm/speculative.test.ts including DAG cycle detection, independent batching, contradiction & duplicate resolution, and >50% latency reduction.

Goal 2 completed: Integrated speculative parallel execution and conflict resolution into src/swarm/engine.ts Step 4; emitted Speculative Parallel Execution and Conflict Resolution telemetry events; verified multi-chunk concurrent execution, conflict arbitration, and fallback across 2/2 integration tests in src/swarm/speculative-engine.test.ts.

Goal 3 completed: Exported speculative module from library exports and package.json; rebuilt client and swarm distribution bundles (dist/ and dist/swarm/); verified CommonJS and ESM dist exports with DependencyGraph, ConflictResolver, and SpeculativeExecutionCoordinator; passed 100% of all 14 vitest suites (107/107 tests) and all 5 E2E test suites (test:portable, test:simulation, test:dist, test:cli, test:server).
Ultragoal session initialized: Deploy continuous learning loops with automated A/B testing of agent configurations against production metrics.

Goal 1 completed: Implemented AgentExperimentManager, AgentExperiment, and StatisticalAnalyzer in src/swarm/experiment.ts; verified 12/12 passing unit tests in src/swarm/experiment.test.ts including Welch's t-test, composite utility scoring, deterministic hashing, Thompson sampling, circuit-breaker rollbacks, and automated statistical promotion.

Goal 2 completed: Integrated automated A/B testing and continuous learning loops into src/swarm/engine.ts (resolving active variant configurations, applying prompt/parameter overrides, capturing execution metrics, and emitting A/B testing telemetry); verified 3/3 passing integration tests in src/swarm/experiment-engine.test.ts.

Goal 3 completed: Exported experiment module from library exports and package.json; rebuilt client and swarm distribution bundles (dist/ and dist/swarm/); verified CommonJS and ESM dist exports with AgentExperimentManager, AgentExperiment, and StatisticalAnalyzer; passed 100% of all 16 vitest suites (122/122 tests) and all 5 E2E test suites (test:portable, test:simulation, test:dist, test:cli, test:server).
Ultragoal session initialized: Adopt token-aware prompt compression using semantic deduplication to cut context costs by 30-50%.

Goal 1 completed: Implemented TokenAwarePromptCompressor, SemanticDeduplicator, token budgeting, and priority pruning in src/swarm/compression.ts; verified 17/17 passing unit tests in src/swarm/compression.test.ts including 30-50% context reduction, anomaly preservation, and multi-agent report deduplication.

Goal 2 completed: Integrated token-aware prompt compression and semantic deduplication into src/swarm/engine.ts and src/swarm/types.ts; added SwarmCompressionSettings and compression metrics to SwarmWorkflowResult; verified 3/3 passing integration tests in src/swarm/compression-engine.test.ts and 142/142 tests passing across 18 Vitest suites.

Goal 3 completed: Exported compression module from library exports and package.json; added @perfect-swarm/core/compression subpath export; rebuilt client and swarm distribution bundles (dist/ and dist/swarm/); updated test-dist-import.mjs and test-dist-import.cjs to verify TokenAwarePromptCompressor, TokenEstimator, and SemanticDeduplicator; verified 100% passing across all 18 Vitest suites (142/142 tests) and all 5 E2E test suites (test:portable, test:simulation, test:dist, test:cli, test:server).
Ultragoal session initialized: Introduce adaptive load-balancing and task-scheduling for optimal resource allocation.

Goal 1 completed: Implemented AdaptiveTaskScheduler, PriorityTaskQueue, TokenBucketRateLimiter, PredictiveLatencyModel, and WorkStealingPool in src/swarm/scheduler.ts; verified 18/18 passing unit tests in src/swarm/scheduler.test.ts covering strict priority order, starvation aging, rate-limit replenishment, EWMA latency prediction, work-stealing, and SJF/fair-share scheduling.

Goal 2 completed: Integrated AdaptiveTaskScheduler into src/swarm/engine.ts and src/swarm/types.ts; added SwarmSchedulingSettings and scheduling metrics to SwarmWorkflowResult; wired telemetry events (Task Scheduled, Work Stolen, Queue Backpressure Delayed, Adaptive Task Scheduling); verified 3/3 passing integration tests in src/swarm/scheduler-engine.test.ts and 163/163 tests passing across 20 Vitest suites.

Goal 3 completed: Exported scheduler module from library exports and package.json; added @perfect-swarm/core/scheduler subpath export; rebuilt client and swarm distribution bundles (dist/ and dist/swarm/); updated test-dist-import.mjs and test-dist-import.cjs to verify AdaptiveTaskScheduler, PriorityTaskQueue, TokenBucketRateLimiter, PredictiveLatencyModel, and WorkStealingPool; verified 100% passing across all 20 Vitest suites (163/163 tests) and all 5 E2E test suites (test:portable, test:simulation, test:dist, test:cli, test:server).
